description: One of a decision's questions, as System One has them: noul (yes or no: the probability it's true), choice (one of criteria's options, by name) or score (an ordered rubric, criteria's levels from low to high).

type.description: What kind of question it is.

instructions.description: Text, or structured data the decider renders as it does text.

criteria.description: choice: each option's name and what it means (null for a bare name); score: its levels, lowest first; noul: what true and false mean, or nothing.
